texts.Events_Sponsor_DeliverableNeedsName: Enter what the sponsor is owed, for example Logo for the program.
texts.Events_Sponsor_Duplicate: {0} is already a sponsor of this event. Edit the sponsor already there.
texts.Events_Sponsor_LevelOtherEvent: That level belongs to another event. Choose a level of this event.
texts.Events_Sponsors_Empty: No sponsors yet. Choose a level if you like, then pick an organization above to add it as a sponsor.
texts.Events_Sponsors_Intro: Sponsorship for this event. Add a level for each tier with its amount, benefits and the deliverables it starts a sponsor with, then add each sponsoring organization. A sponsor starts with its level's amount and checklist. BarnCRM records what a sponsor owes; payments are taken outside BarnCRM.
texts.Events_Sponsors_LevelsEmpty: No levels yet. Add one, such as Gold, with its amount, benefits and the deliverables list.
texts.Events_Sponsors_LoadFailed: The sponsors could not be loaded. Try again. If it happens again, ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.
texts.Events_Sponsors_RemoveLevelConfirm: Remove the level {0}? Sponsors at this level stay and have no level. Their amounts and deliverables are kept.
texts.Events_Sponsors_RemoveSponsorConfirm: Remove {0} as a sponsor? Its deliverables checklist is deleted too. The organization stays in BarnCRM.
texts.Events_Applications_AcceptConfirm: Accept the proposal from {0}? They become a speaker at this event, and the accepted notice goes out if a template is chosen in Events settings.
texts.Events_Applications_Decided: This application has already been decided. Nothing was changed.
texts.Events_Applications_DeclineConfirm: Decline the proposal from {0}? The declined notice goes out if a template is chosen in Events settings.
texts.Events_Applications_Done_Accepted: Application accepted. The applicant is now a speaker at this event.
texts.Events_Applications_Empty: No applications yet. Add one for each proposal that comes in.
texts.Events_Applications_Intro: The call for speakers. Proposals are listed best average score first. Use a proposal's menu to score it, then accept or decline it. Each reviewer has one score per proposal, and a new score replaces the old one.
texts.Events_Applications_LoadFailed: The applications could not be loaded. Try again. If it happens again, ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.
texts.Events_Applications_NoApplicant: This application has no applicant, so there is no one to make a speaker. Add the applicant first.
texts.Events_Notice_NoEmail: No notice was sent: the applicant has no email address.
texts.Events_Notice_NoTemplate: No notice was sent: no email template is chosen in Events settings.
texts.Events_Notice_Sent: The notice was emailed to the applicant.
texts.Events_Notice_SendFailed: The notice could not be sent. The decision is saved.
texts.Events_Notice_TemplateMissing: No notice was sent: the email template chosen in Events settings was not found or is inactive.
texts.Events_Agenda_Empty: No tracks or sessions yet. Add a track for each strand of the event, then add its sessions.
texts.Events_Agenda_Intro: The event's sessions by track. Move a session with its menu, or drag its handle, or press Space on the handle and use the arrow keys. Clashes are flagged, never refused.
texts.Events_Agenda_LoadFailed: The agenda could not be loaded. Try again. If it happens again, ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.
texts.Events_Agenda_RoomClash: Same room at the same time as {0}
texts.Events_Agenda_SpeakerClash: A speaker is also in {0} at the same time
texts.Events_Agenda_Truncated: Showing the first {0} sessions. Use the Event Sessions reports to see the rest.
texts.Events_Appointments_AddFailed: The slots could not be added and nothing was saved. Check that every slot falls inside the event's dates, then try again. If it happens again, ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.
texts.Events_Appointments_BadSlots: Add between 1 and {0} slots at a time. Nothing was saved.
texts.Events_Appointments_BadStatus: That status cannot be set here. Nothing was changed.
texts.Events_Appointments_Capped: Only the first {0} slots are added in one go.
texts.Events_Appointments_Empty: No appointment slots yet. Choose a host, a day, a time window and a slot length, then add the slots.
texts.Events_Appointments_Gone: That slot is no longer there. Reload the tab.
texts.Events_Appointments_HostClash: Overlaps another slot of this host
texts.Events_Appointments_Intro: Bookable slots with a host during the event, such as mentor or advisor time. Book a person into an open slot from its menu. Overlapping slots of one host are flagged, never refused.
texts.Events_Appointments_Invalid_Length: A slot is from 5 to 480 minutes long.
texts.Events_Appointments_Invalid_Times: Choose a start time, and an end time after it.
texts.Events_Appointments_LoadFailed: The appointments could not be loaded. Try again. If it happens again, ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.
texts.Events_Appointments_NoPerson: Book a person into the slot first. Nothing was changed.
texts.Events_Appointments_NotOpen: That slot is not open any more. Nothing was changed.
texts.Events_Appointments_Outside: Some of these slots fall outside the event's dates and will be refused.
texts.Events_Appointments_PersonBusy: That person is already booked at the same time with another host. Nothing was changed.
texts.Events_Appointments_SaveFailed: The change could not be saved. Try again. If it happens again, ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.
texts.Events_Appointments_Skipped: {0} slots overlap this host's existing slots and are left out.
texts.Events_Dashboard_ApplyFailed: The template could not be applied and nothing was added. Check that the event's start and end dates leave room for it, then try again. If it happens again, ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.
texts.Events_Dashboard_Applied: Template applied: {0} sessions added as drafts, with their tracks and ticket types.
texts.Events_Dashboard_Intro: Where the event stands. Counts are for this event only.
texts.Events_Dashboard_LoadFailed: The dashboard could not be loaded. Try again. If it happens again, ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.
texts.Events_Dashboard_NotEmpty: A template can only be applied to an event with no ticket types, tracks or sessions. Nothing was added.
texts.Events_Dashboard_TemplateIntro: Start from a ready-made plan instead of an empty event. Nothing is added until you press Apply Template, and a template only adds drafts you can change.
texts.Events_Dashboard_TemplateSkipped: {0} sessions fall outside the event's dates and are left out.
texts.Events_Dashboard_TemplateSummary: Adds {0} tracks, {1} ticket types and {2} sessions.
texts.Events_Volunteers_BadShift: A shift needs a start, an end after it, and at least one volunteer. Nothing was saved.
texts.Events_Volunteers_Empty: No volunteer jobs for this event yet. Add a job, such as Registration Desk, then add its shifts.
texts.Events_Volunteers_Intro: Volunteer jobs and shifts for this event. They are kept in Volunteers, where people sign up and hours are logged.
texts.Events_Volunteers_LoadFailed: The volunteer jobs could not be loaded. Try again. If it happens again, ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.
texts.Events_Volunteers_NameRequired: Give the job a name. Nothing was saved.
texts.Events_Volunteers_Problem_Needed: Ask for a whole number of volunteers, at least 1.
texts.Events_Volunteers_Problem_Outside: A shift inside the event's dates is expected. You can still add this one.
texts.Events_Volunteers_Problem_Times: Choose a start, and an end after it.
texts.Events_Volunteers_SaveFailed: The change could not be saved. You may need the Volunteers permission to add jobs and shifts. Try again. If it happens again, ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.
texts.Events_Volunteers_Summary: {0} jobs and {1} shifts, {2} of {3} volunteers signed up.
texts.Events_Home_EmptyPast: No past events yet. Events show here once they end or are cancelled.
texts.Events_Home_EmptyUpcoming: Nothing coming up. Create an event to start planning it.
texts.Events_Home_Intro: Every event the organization runs. Open one to set up its tickets, agenda and speakers.
texts.Events_Home_LoadFailed: The events could not be loaded. Try again. If it happens again, ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.
texts.Events_Home_Truncated: Showing the first {0} events. Use the list views on the Events tab to see the rest.
texts.Events_Repeat_BadDates: Each new date must be after the event's own start. Nothing was saved.
texts.Events_PromoCode_Duplicate: The code {0} is already used for this event. Choose another code, or edit the one already there.
texts.Events_Emails_NoTemplate: No event email went: there is no email template with the unique name {0}. Check the template named in Events settings.
texts.Events_Emails_SendFailed: {0} of {1} event emails could not be sent and will be tried again tomorrow. One reason: {2}
texts.Events_Summit_ImportFailed: {0} of {1} Summit Events registrations could not be imported and will be tried again while they stay recently changed. One reason: {2}
texts.Events_Register_AllRegistered: Nobody new to register: {0} already registered for this event.
texts.Events_Register_BadCode: The code {0} cannot be used for this event now. Check the code, or register without it.
texts.Events_Register_CodeNotForTicket: That code is not for the chosen tickets. Choose the ticket it is for, or register without it.
texts.Events_Register_CodeUsedUp: The code {0} has been used as many times as it allows.
texts.Events_Register_EventCancelled: This event is cancelled, so nobody can register for it.
texts.Events_Register_LastNameNeeded: Give each person a last name, or pick them from your people.
texts.Events_Register_ManyPeople: More than one person in BarnCRM matches. Pick the right person from your people instead.
texts.Events_Register_NoEvent: The event could not be found. It may have been deleted.
texts.Events_Register_NoPerson: One of the people could not be found or read. Pick them again.
texts.Events_Register_NoSeat: No seat is free on the event or on this ticket. Free a seat first, or leave them on the waitlist.
texts.Events_Register_UnknownTicket: The ticket type {0} is not an active ticket for this event.
texts.Events_Registrations_CancelConfirm: Cancel {0} and everyone on it? Their seats are freed. You can mark each person registered again later.
texts.Events_Registrations_Empty: Nobody has registered yet. Click New Registration to register someone, or link a BarnCRM Forms form in the event's Registration Form Key.
texts.Events_Registrations_Intro: Who registered and who attends. BarnCRM finds each person among your people before creating anyone, and puts guests in the registrant's household. When the event is full, new people go on the waitlist.
texts.Events_Registrations_LoadFailed: The registrations could not be loaded. Try again. If it happens again, ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.
texts.Events_Registrations_SummarySeats: {0} holding a seat, {1} waitlisted, {2} attended, {3} seats left.
texts.Events_Registrations_Truncated: Showing the first 2,000 attendees. Use the Event Attendees reports to see the rest.
texts.Events_Repeat_Intro: Each new date gets a draft copy of {0}, as long as the event, with its ticket types and tracks, linked to the first event of the series.
texts.Events_Repeat_NoPermission: You do not have access to create events. Ask your BarnCRM admin for the Events Staff permission set.
texts.Events_SessionSpeaker_Duplicate: This speaker is already in this session.
texts.Events_Shared_DeleteConfirm: Delete {0}? This cannot be undone here, but it stays in the Recycle Bin for 15 days.
texts.Events_Shared_NotSaved: Nothing was saved. Try again. If it happens again, ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.
texts.Events_Speaker_Duplicate: {0} is already a speaker at this event.
texts.Events_Speakers_Empty: No speakers yet. Pick a person above to add them as a speaker.
texts.Events_Speakers_Intro: The people speaking at this event. Pick a person to add them, then use their menu to put them in sessions or fill in their bio and needs.
texts.Events_Speakers_LoadFailed: The speakers could not be loaded. Try again. If it happens again, ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.
texts.Events_Speakers_RemoveConfirm: Remove {0} as a speaker? They are taken out of their sessions too. The person stays in BarnCRM.
texts.Events_Tickets_Intro: The kinds of ticket this event offers and the codes that give a discount. BarnCRM records prices and takes no payments.
texts.Events_Tickets_LoadFailed: The tickets could not be loaded. Try again. If it happens again, ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.
texts.Events_Tickets_NoCodes: No promo codes. Add one to give a discount on this event's tickets.
texts.Events_Tickets_NoTickets: No ticket types yet. Add one, such as General or Student, with its price.
texts.Events_Tickets_OverCapacity: The ticket quantities add up to {0}, more than the event's capacity of {1}. That is allowed, since not every ticket sells, but check it is what you want.
